title: Systemic Immune Inflammatory Index in Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
off: Association of Systemic Immune Inflammatory Index With Disease Activity and Lupus Nephritis in Patients With Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
summary: This study aims to investigate the association between the systemic immune-inflammation index and disease activity, as well as lupus nephritis in patients with systemic lupus erythematosus
elig:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Older than 16 years
* clinical diagnosis of systemic lupus erythematosus
* In patients with LN, patients whose diagnosis is confirmed by kidney biopsy and pathohistological verification

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with other autoimmune rheumatological diseases
* Lymphoproliferative disorders
* malignancies.
* active infections.
* recent history of blood transfusion

arms.l: patients diagnosed with systemic lupus and lupus nephritis
arms.d: this group will include 30 patients, all patients will undergo the following: For the evaluation of SLE clinical disease activity SLEDAI ( systemic upus erythematosus disease activity index)scores will be recorded The SII (systemic immune inflammatory index) will be calculatedusing the following formula: SII = (neutrophil count × platelet count)/lymphocyte count.

arms.l: patients diagnosed with systemic lupus without lupus nephritis
arms.d: this group will also include 30 patients, all patients will undergo the following: For the evaluation of SLE clinical disease activity SLEDAI ( systemic upus erythematosus disease activity index)scores will be recorded The SII (systemic immune inflammatory index) will be calculated using the following formula: SII = (neutrophil count × platelet count)/lymphocyte count.
